gift.title: Send this ticket to a friend.
gift.subtitle: They'll get it instantly and it becomes theirs the moment they claim it — their own name, their own QR code.

gift.howDeadlineAfter: to claim. Unclaimed, it comes straight back to you, still valid.

resell.title: Let someone else take your seat.
resell.subtitle: Your ticket goes up on the MyTicket auction. Buyers bid or buy instantly, the transfer is handled for you, and the money lands in your wallet.
resell.closeNote: Listings always close at least 6 hours before doors, so the buyer can plan their night.
resell.ifSells: If it sells at your starting bid
resell.paidNote: You paid SAR {{paid}} for this ticket. Bids can't climb past your starting price — you keep 90% of wherever it lands.
resell.ruleCancelBefore: You can cancel the listing any time
resell.ruleCancelAfter: — after that it must run its course.
resell.ruleWhileListed: While listed, the ticket can't be used, gifted, or refunded.
resell.ruleSold: Sold: it transfers to the buyer and your QR stops working. Unsold: it comes back to you, still valid for the night.

refund.title: Can't make it? Get your money back.
refund.subtitle: You're inside the free cancellation window. The refund goes to your MyTicket wallet, where you can spend it or withdraw it to your bank.

steps.submittedBody: You'll get a confirmation straight away, and your ticket pauses from resale or gifting.
steps.reviewBody: Usually 1–2 working days. We'll notify you either way.
steps.walletBody: Withdrawable to your bank, or ready for the next show.

refund.policyBody: "Full refund of the ticket price until 48 hours before doors (Mon 5 Oct, 18:30). No refunds after that point, except if the event is cancelled or rescheduled. The MyTicket platform fee is not refundable." — Nights Entertainment Co.
refund.ticketPrice: Ticket price · Gold · Floor A · Row C · Seat 12
refund.handleNoteBefore: MyTicket handles the refund. Requests inside the window are usually approved within
refund.handleNoteAfter: , and the money lands in your wallet as withdrawable balance. Your ticket stays valid until the refund is approved.
refund.ratherBefore: If the show is in demand, you might get more by

refund.ratherAfter: — you'd receive 90% of the sale price.
